title: Residential Lease

origin.publisher: Arkansas REALTORS® Association (form); completed by a Century 21 Prestige Realty agent
origin.title: Residential Lease/Rental Agreement, executed November 17, 2023
origin.clearance_note: A real residential lease on the Arkansas REALTORS® Association's standard form, completed and e-signed through a Century 21 brokerage, uploaded to Scribd by a third party and downloaded manually, because Scribd blocks scripted requests. Scribd is a user-upload site, so the lease is treated as a personal record. The tenant's, agent's and principal broker's names (including their typed e-signatures), the agent's personal email and mobile number from every page's footer, the rental property's address, the form serial number and the e-signature session ID were replaced using document-types/scripts/redact.py, which removes the underlying text rather than covering it: names, address and email with obviously-fake equivalents, the phone number in the 555-01xx range, the serial number with a plausible random stand-in, and the session ID with a freshly generated random ID. The PDF metadata was cleared. The brokerage's name, logo and office address, and the lease's terms and amounts, are left as printed. Verified: no original identifier is extractable from the committed PDF, and none appears anywhere in this collection folder.

redactions.note: The original values are deliberately NOT recorded here. Writing them beside their replacements would republish the personal data the redaction removed. The rules file used by redact.py stays outside the repo.

replaced.what: tenant's name, including the typed e-signature
agent's name, including the typed e-signature and page footers
principal broker's name, including the typed e-signature
agent's personal email address, page footers

notes: The request named no feature page or fields. Features the lease's basics on page 1: who manages it, how long it runs, the rent and the deposit. No person is featured. Every rent-section value (monthly amount, due day, late charge, late-after day, insufficient-funds fee) grounds to the whole Rent paragraph: the typed values are overlaid on the form's blank lines and parse into the paragraph's text, so they would all render the same crop, and only the monthly rent is featured. term.length grounds to two lines. The signatures array extracts every signature line, but pairs names and roles across the signature page's two columns: the tenant's name comes back under Management and both agents under Tenant, and the is_signed flags follow the wrong lines. It is not featured. preview_pages includes page 6, the signature page, in place of the default's page 3.
